第19章 院长抢人悻悻而归（第1页）
大地震颤，金光如潮水般席卷天际。
巨大的动静，顷刻间惊动整个狼园。
附近新生觅得方向，先后狂奔至此。
虚空，传来阵阵鹰啸兽吼之声，震耳欲聋。
一只巨大黑鹰划破长空至此，鹰背上站着一名中年男子。
其目光如鹰隼般锐利，紧盯着真武塔第九层，低声自语，“还没出来吗？”
此人，正是天武书院外院第四院院长。
四院院长眉头一下锁起，脸色阴沉地望向天武书院的方向，“再过一会儿，那三个家伙也都要来了。”
话音刚落，天空中又传来两声呼啸。
两只飞行妖兽振翅而来，背上分别站着两名中年男子。
一人身着青袍，面容冷峻，另一人身穿灰衣，嘴角挂着淡淡的笑意，是第二院和第三院的院长。
二院院长低声言语，注视着真武塔大门，很期待叶凡从真武塔内走出来。
“我先到的这里，你们俩个可别跟我抢！”
四院院长横眉冷目警告两人，似对叶凡志在必得。
三院院长戏谑一笑，毫不退让，“你先到这，人就归你？哪门子道理？通关真武塔的天才，进你四院可就埋没了。”
四院院长冷斥道，“此子拜入我门下，我这当师尊的，还能亏待他不成？待遇，自然跟寻常四院弟子不同！”

紫衫少妇人，外院第一院院长紫苑。
同时，也是沐倾城在天武书院的师尊。
紫苑嘴角含笑，对沐倾城点头示意，随后目光转向真武塔，眼中闪过一丝深意。
二院院长不喜紫苑的到来，锁眉质问道，“你不是说，你不收男性弟子吗？”
二院院长一时语塞，扫了眼此地众学员。
三院院长闻声大笑，“皇城叶家的少爷！哈哈……紫苑，此子怕是与你无师徒之缘。”
紫苑脸庞笑容依旧，一本正经道，“真正的天才，不分男女。”
四院院长闻言，忍不住怒骂道，“当初自己立下的誓言都要背弃，跟我们几个抢弟子！”
四位院长争论不休，场面一度剑拔弩张。

Chapter 19 The dean robbed someone and returned in anger (page 1)
The earth trembled, and golden light swept across the sky like a tide.
The huge movement immediately shocked the entire wolf park.
The freshmen nearby found their way and rushed here one after another.
In the void, bursts of roaring eagles and beasts were heard, deafening.
A huge black eagle streaked across the sky, with a middle-aged man standing on the eagle's back.
His eyes were as sharp as a falcon, staring at the ninth floor of the Zhenwu Tower, whispering to himself, "Aren't you out yet?"
This person is the dean of the fourth outer courtyard of Tianwu Academy.
The Dean of the Fourth Academy frowned and looked in the direction of Tianwu Academy with a gloomy expression, "In a while, those three guys will be here too."
As soon as he finished speaking, two more whistles came from the sky.
Two flying monsters fluttered their wings, with two middle-aged men standing on their backs.
One person was wearing a green robe with a stern face, and the other person was wearing a gray robe with a faint smile on his lips. He was the dean of the second and third houses.
The dean of the Second Academy spoke in a low voice and stared at the gate of Zhenwu Tower, looking forward to Ye Fan walking out of Zhenwu Tower.
"I got here first, you two, don't fight me!"
The Dean of the Fourth Hospital warned the two of them with cold eyes, as if he was determined to win Ye Fan.
The dean of the Third Courtyard laughed jokingly and did not give in. "If you get here first, the person will be yours? What kind of truth is that? The genius who has passed the Zhenwu Tower will be buried in your Fourth Courtyard."
The dean of the Fourth Academy coldly scolded, "This boy has become my disciple. As a master, how can I treat him badly? The treatment is naturally different from the ordinary disciples of the Fourth Academy!"
A young woman in a purple shirt, Ziyuan, the dean of the first courtyard of the outer courtyard.
At the same time, he is also Mu Qingcheng’s master in Tianwu Academy.
Ziyuan smiled and nodded to Mu Qingcheng, then turned her eyes to the Zhenwu Pagoda, with a hint of deep meaning in her eyes.
The dean of the Second Academy was not happy with Ziyuan's arrival, and asked with a frown, "Didn't you say that you don't accept male disciples?"
The dean of the Second Academy was speechless for a moment and glanced at the students here.
The dean of the third hospital heard the sound and laughed, "The young master of the Ye family in the imperial city! Haha... Ziyuan, I am afraid that this son has no master-disciple relationship with you."
Ziyuan still had a smile on her face and said seriously, "True geniuses are men and women."
When the Dean of the Fourth Academy heard this, he couldn't help but cursed angrily, "I will break the oath I made back then and compete with a few of us to steal disciples!"
The four deans argued endlessly, and the situation was tense for a time.
